text.4:94: O ye who believe! When ye go forth (to fight) in the way of Allah, be careful to discriminate, and say not unto one who offereth you peace: "Thou art not a believer," seeking the chance profits of this life (so that ye may despoil him). With Allah are plenteous spoils. Even thus (as he now is) were ye before; but Allah hath since then been gracious unto you. Therefore take care to discriminate. Allah is ever Informed of what ye do.
text.5:16: Whereby Allah guideth him who seeketh His good pleasure unto paths of peace. He bringeth them out of darkness unto light by His decree, and guideth them unto a straight path.
text.6:54: And when those who believe in Our revelations come unto thee, say: Peace be unto you! Your Lord hath prescribed for Himself mercy, that whoso of you doeth evil through ignorance and repenteth afterward thereof and doeth right, (for him) lo! He is Forgiving, Merciful.
text.6:127: For them is the abode of peace with their Lord. He will be their Protecting Friend because of what they used to do.
text.7:46: Between them is a veil. And on the Heights are men who know them all by their marks. And they call unto the dwellers of the Garden: Peace be unto you! They enter it not although they hope (to enter).
text.10:10: Their prayer therein will be: Glory be to Thee, O Allah! and their greeting therein will be: Peace. And the conclusion of their prayer will be: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
text.10:25: And Allah summoneth to the abode of peace, and leadeth whom He will to a straight path.
text.11:48: It was said (unto him): O Noah! Go thou down (from the mountain) with peace from Us and blessings upon thee and some nations (that will spring) from those with thee. (There will be other) nations unto whom We shall give enjoyment a long while and then a painful doom from Us will overtake them.
text.11:69: And Our messengers cam unto Abraham with good news. They said: Peace! He answered: Peace! and delayed not to bring a roasted calf.
text.13:24: (Saying): Peace be unto you because ye persevered. Ah, passing sweet will be the sequel of the (heavenly) Home.
text.14:23: And those who believed and did good works are made to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein abiding by permission of their Lord, their greeting therein: Peace!
text.15:46: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.
text.15:52: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.
text.16:32: Those whom the angels cause to die (when they are) good. They say: Peace be unto you! Enter the Garden because of what ye used to do.
text.19:15: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!
text.19:33: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!
text.19:47: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.
text.19:62: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
text.20:47: So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance.
text.21:69: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,
text.25:63: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;
text.25:75: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,
text.27:59: Say (O Muhammad): Praise be to Allah, and peace be on His slaves whom He hath chosen! Is Allah best, or (all) that ye ascribe as partners (unto Him)?
text.28:55: And when they hear vanity they withdraw from it and say: Unto us our works and unto you your works. Peace be unto you! We desire not the ignorant.
text.33:44: Their salutation on the day when they shall meet Him will be: Peace. And He hath prepared for them a goodly recompense.
text.36:58: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
text.37:79: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
text.37:120: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!
text.37:181: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
text.39:73: And those who keep their duty to their Lord are driven unto the Garden in troops till, when they reach it, and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Peace be unto you! Ye are good, so enter ye (the Garden of delight), to dwell therein;
text.43:89: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
text.50:34: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
text.51:25: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
text.56:26: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
text.56:91: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
text.59:23: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).
text.97:5: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
